originalInput: Verified site EPUB, 10-volume set; existing content blocks are native text units, not OCR page fragments.
scope: Preserve all current paragraph boundaries; this stops the reader from guessing OCR continuation joins. It does not certify that every older data block has already been split correctly against the original source.
